lines: No API key available. Your config reads it from "COMPAT_API_KEY", which is not set in the environment and has nothi
ng stored for it. Fix it in whichever way suits you: run "auth:set --env-var=COMPAT_API_KEY" to store the key on th
is machine (kept in an owner-only file, so no shell export is needed again); or export COMPAT_API_KEY in your shell
; or pass it per run from a password manager, e.g. COMPAT_API_KEY=$(pass show anthropic/api-key) symfony-security-a
uditor audit . — run "auth:status --env-var=COMPAT_API_KEY" to see what is currently resolved.
